articles.primary_category: Supreme Court Judgments and Important Legal Developments

detailedExplanation: Following its 5-Judge Constitution Bench verdict (4:1) upholding Section 6A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, the Supreme Court directed time-bound border fencing and tribunal digitization. Section 6A gives statutory effect to the 1985 Assam Accord, fixing March 25, 1971 as the cut-off date for citizenship registration in Assam.

The Court held that Parliament possesses plenary legislative competence under Article 11 to enact special citizenship provisions. Persons who entered Assam before January 1, 1966 were deemed citizens; those entering between Jan 1, 1966 and March 24, 1971 were eligible after a 10-year disenfranchisement period. Those entering on or after March 25, 1971 are declared illegal immigrants to be detected and deported through Foreigners Tribunals.
